unit.name: Research recipes
unit.responsibility: CLI lane for phase 2. (1) Named DuckDB recipes over the published views answering the consumer brief's 14 questions and the fleet questions (idle tax, compaction cadence, peer amplification, subagent fan-out, tool loops, fleet idle-longest, most expensive turns, daily token cost by repo/model/harness — token classes, no authoritative pricing); `unisphere prep recipes` and `unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR` printing a self-contained script that reads TARGET/views.sql; bundled research-recipes docs topic with the one-line command and the actionable no-duckdb message. The printed script is `SET file_search_path = '<abs TARGET>';` then `.read '<abs TARGET>/views.sql'` then the query, so the documented use is `unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR | duckdb`. (2) `--max-snapshot-bytes N` and `--max-snapshot-records N` on `unisphere prep` feeding PrepReadLimits.snapshot (AC-000c adjustable bounds). (3) The prep docs topic states current harness coverage; this closes the phase-1 composition review's low finding.
unit.interface: run_prep_recipes(&PrepRecipesCommand, stdout, stderr) -> u8; run_prep_recipe(&PrepRecipeCommand, stdout, stderr) -> u8; ParsedCommand::{PrepRecipes, PrepRecipe}.
unit.notes: No engine is linked and the CLI never shells out. Port the POC recipe set (/Users/jordanknight/substrate/unisphere/unishpere-main/scratch/poc-prep-duckdb/prep_sql.py, 30 DuckDB recipes over the v1 schema) to the v2 views; the consumer's questions are in ~/games/unasphere/scratch/unisphere-feedback/usecase-brief.md. DuckDB CLI is installed (/opt/homebrew/bin/duckdb) for local validation; tests must not require it; the PM's vd-000c is the external-engine proof.
